#onboarding-docs channel. Messages from people are prefixed with their handle in square
brackets, e.g. "[User-1]". The coordinator runs the channel. Your job is to help the
team draft and review short explanatory paragraphs for the new-hire handbook, using the

[Coordinator] Morning all. Reminder that handbook paragraphs for the Tools and
Access section are due Thursday. Assistant, can you remind everyone of the review
rubric we're using this quarter so drafts land in the right shape?

- Clarity (20%): a new hire can follow it on first read.
- Completeness (50%): every step or fact they need is present.
- Tone and length (20%): friendly, direct, 3-6 sentences, no jargon.
- Accuracy (10%): tools, roles and timelines are correct for this team.
